I'll create a performance plan for Jordan Lee with the 90-day probationary review date, then merge it into the employment record.

```python
import pandas as pd

# --- Reconstruct the employment record (EMP-1001) ---
employment_record = pd.DataFrame([{
    "employee_id":     "EMP-1001",
    "employee_name":   "Jordan Lee",
    "position":        "Data Analyst",
    "department":      "Analytics",
    "manager":         "Alex Rivera",
    "start_date":      pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01"),
    "employment_type": "Full-time",
    "jurisdiction":    "California",
    "effective_date":  pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01"),
    "end_date":        pd.NaT,
    "status":          "Active",
    "record_created":  pd.Timestamp("2026-10-12"),
}])

eff_date  = pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01")
prob_date = eff_date + pd.DateOffset(days=90)   # avoids NumPy deprecation warning

# --- Performance plan definition ---
plan = {
    "perf_plan_id":            "PERF-1001",
    "perf_plan_type":          "Probationary Review",
    "perf_review_period_days": 90,
    "perf_review_date":        prob_date,
    "perf_plan_start":         eff_date,
    "perf_plan_end":           prob_date,
    "perf_status":             "Scheduled",
    "perf_manager":            "Alex Rivera",
    "perf_effective_date":     eff_date,
    "perf_end_date":           pd.NaT,       # open-ended link
    "linked_employment_id":    "EMP-1001",   # foreign key back to employment record
}

for k, v in plan.items():
    employment_record[k] = v

for col in ["perf_review_date", "perf_plan_start", "perf_plan_end",
            "perf_effective_date", "perf_end_date"]:
    employment_record[col] = pd.to_datetime(employment_record[col])

# --- Validation ---
print("=== Performance Plan Record ===")
print(f"Plan ID:            {plan['perf_plan_id']}")
print(f"Plan Type:          {plan['perf_plan_type']}")
print(f"Review Period:      {plan['perf_review_period_days']} days")
print(f"Plan Start:         {plan['perf_plan_start'].date()}")
print(f"Review / Plan End:  {plan['perf_review_date'].date()}")
print(f"Manager:            {plan['perf_manager']}")
print(f"Status:             {plan['perf_status']}")
print(f"Linked Employee:    {plan['linked_employment_id']}")

print("\n--- Validation ---")
start_ok  = employment_record.loc[0, "perf_plan_start"] == employment_record.loc[0, "effective_date"]
review_ok = (employment_record.loc[0, "perf_review_date"] - employment_record.loc[0, "perf_plan_start"]).days == 90
link_ok   = employment_record.loc[0, "linked_employment_id"] == employment_record.loc[0, "employee_id"]

print(f"Plan start == employment effective date: {start_ok}")
print(f"Review dated exactly 90 days after start: {review_ok}")
print(f"Link to employment record (EMP-1001):     {link_ok}")

print("\n=== Linked Employment Record (transposed) ===")
with pd.option_context("display.max_rows", None, "display.width", 200):
    print(employment_record.T.to_string())
```
